title: archive_signal in fix_signal executes before signal is resolved; archive must move to accept_candidate
description: fix_signal calls archive_signal at the end of its own run, but at that point the signal status is only in_progress — no spec has been written, no run has executed, and no PR has been accepted. archive_signal requires the signal to be resolved or superseded before proceeding; called against an in_progress signal it always fails the integrity check and emits a fallback SkillImprovement error signal. The symptom of this was captured as b2c3d4e5-f6a7-4b8c-9d0e-1f2a3b4c5d6e. The archive step belongs in accept_candidate, immediately after Phase 2 sets status to resolved.
proposed_resolution: Remove the ## Archive Resolved Signal section from fix_signal.skill.md. Add a new Phase 2b to accept_candidate.skill.md immediately after Phase 2 — Resolve, which calls archive_signal with the resolved signal_id and resolution_summary. Port the error-fallback pattern (emit a SkillImprovement signal if archive_signal returns an error, continue regardless) to the new location.
